indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_publication_channel_stream_state_status ON publication.channel_stream_state USING btree (publication_stream_id, status, onboarding_mode, channel_id)

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX channel_commands_pkey ON remote_ingestion.channel_commands USING btree (command_id)

indexes.name: remote_channel_scope_lease
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX remote_channel_scope_lease ON remote_ingestion.tasks USING btree (scope_key) WHERE ((scope_key IS NOT NULL) AND (state = 'leased'::text))

indexes.name: remote_task_target_slot
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX remote_task_target_slot ON remote_ingestion.tasks USING btree (target_node_id, target_worker_slot, created_at)

indexes.name: remote_tasks_claim
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX remote_tasks_claim ON remote_ingestion.tasks USING btree (capability, created_at) WHERE (state = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'leased'::text]))

indexes.name: remote_tasks_live_lease_lookup
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX remote_tasks_live_lease_lookup ON remote_ingestion.tasks USING btree (node_id, lease_until, worker_slot) INCLUDE (task_id, generation, scope_key) WHERE (state = 'leased'::text)

indexes.name: remote_tasks_live_slot
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX remote_tasks_live_slot ON remote_ingestion.tasks USING btree (target_node_id, target_worker_slot) WHERE (state = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'leased'::text, 'received'::text]))

indexes.name: remote_tasks_node_leases
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX remote_tasks_node_leases ON remote_ingestion.tasks USING btree (node_id, lease_until) WHERE (state = 'leased'::text)

indexes.name: remote_tasks_process
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX remote_tasks_process ON remote_ingestion.tasks USING btree (next_process_at, received_at) WHERE (state = 'received'::text)

indexes.name: remote_tasks_target_pending
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX remote_tasks_target_pending ON remote_ingestion.tasks USING btree (target_node_id, target_worker_slot, capability, created_at, task_id) WHERE (state = 'pending'::text)

indexes.name: remote_tasks_unassigned_claim
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX remote_tasks_unassigned_claim ON remote_ingestion.tasks USING btree (capability, created_at, task_id) WHERE ((target_node_id IS NULL) AND (state = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'leased'::text])))

indexes.name: remote_whole_applied_retention
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX remote_whole_applied_retention ON remote_ingestion.tasks USING btree (applied_at) WHERE (state = 'applied'::text)

indexes.name: remote_worker_slot_lease
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX remote_worker_slot_lease ON remote_ingestion.tasks USING btree (node_id, worker_slot) WHERE ((worker_slot IS NOT NULL) AND (state = 'leased'::text))

indexes.name: tasks_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tasks_pkey ON remote_ingestion.tasks USING btree (task_id)

indexes.name: tasks_work_key_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tasks_work_key_key ON remote_ingestion.tasks USING btree (work_key)

indexes.name: remote_whole_unpruned_task
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX remote_whole_unpruned_task ON remote_ingestion.whole_channel_inputs USING btree (task_id) WHERE (pruned_at IS NULL)

indexes.name: whole_channel_inputs_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX whole_channel_inputs_pkey ON remote_ingestion.whole_channel_inputs USING btree (command_id)

indexes.name: whole_channel_inputs_task_id_generation_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX whole_channel_inputs_task_id_generation_key ON remote_ingestion.whole_channel_inputs USING btree (task_id, generation)

Plans.Filter: ((publication_finalized_at IS NOT NULL) AND (crawl_mode = 'full'::text) AND (publication_finalized_status = 'ready_auto'::text) AND (promotion_candidate.channel_id = channel_id) AND (COALESCE((result_json #>> '{publication_gap_repair,status}'::text[]), ''::text) <> 'required'::text))

(((onboarding_mode = 'bootstrap'::text) AND (seed_status = 'pending'::text) AND ((ownership_reference ->> 'onboarding_mode'::text) = 'automatic_bootstrap'::text) AND ((ownership_reference ->> 'initial_full_run_id'::text) = channel.registry_promotion_run_id)) IS NOT TRUE)
